brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir entered Al-Aqsa Mosque on Tuesday under heavy protection from Israeli police, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incursion marks a continued pattern of visits by Israeli officials to the sensitive compound in occupied East Jerusalem.

Ben-Gvir's entry comes amid ongoing tensions surrounding access to the mosque, one of Islam's holiest sites. His visits have previously drawn Palestinian condemnation and regional concern over potential escalation.
title: Israeli security minister storms Al-Aqsa Mosque under heavy police protection
